decisions.statement: The outline is the whole of knowledge.
The files on disk are how far into the outline Ali has got.
A node's mastery level is judged by hand.
A node with children is scored at a rung of its own just as a node without children is.
A node's coverage is worked out from the children beneath the node.
A topic names the topic above rather than sitting in that topic's folder.
How far Alan has mastered each part of the map is kept with the part.
A topic's mastery level is written to that topic's page and never told to Alan in any form.
The answers Alan got right and the answers Alan got wrong are told to Alan.

definition: how far into the whole of knowledge Ali has read, node by node
